note.specFocus: Hobbies and leisure interests, sport, shopping, reading, cinema, going out with friends, and how free time is spent.
note.sourcePages: Original practice material written to match the AQA GCSE German (8668) themes; no supplied booklet used.
note.summary:
2.1 Free-time activities
Key vocabulary
- die Freizeit = free time
- sich entspannen = to relax
- das Hobby = hobby
- die Mannschaft = team
- die Eintrittskarte = ticket
- ins Kino/einkaufen gehen = to go to cinema/shopping

Key grammar
- Separable verbs in main clauses: ich gehe ... aus, ich sehe ... fern; in infinitives the prefix stays attached.
- gern/lieber/am liebsten compare preferences; use than = als.
- Past events: haben + past participle; movement verbs often use sein: ich bin gegangen/gefahren.

Exam tips
- Use a range of vocabulary but keep German word order accurate.
- Justify opinions with denn/weil and a clear reason; check present, perfect, future and conditional time frames.
- In comprehension, distinguish nicht, kein and nie: negatives may reverse the intended answer.

In meiner Freizeit spiele ich zweimal pro Woche Basketball in einer Mannschaft. Das Konzert war ausverkauft, deshalb haben wir die Musik online angehört. Trotzdem gibt es auch Nachteile, die man beachten muss. In Zukunft möchte ich in diesem Bereich bewusster handeln.

(English sense: a balanced, first-person response addressing free-time activities with opinions and more than one time frame.)
questions.question:
Write about free-time activities. Include: your current habits or views; one past experience; one advantage and disadvantage; your future plans.

Aim for 80–100 words. Use accurate German and develop each bullet; opinions should be justified.
